title: Everyday Phrases — At the Dry Cleaner's
scene_zh: 上乾洗店 · 情境對話
title_quote: Hi, do you do dry cleaning here?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🧥 實用上乾洗店必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At the Dry Cleaner's
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用上乾洗店情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從送洗問價、污漬處理、取衣退賠到改衣會員，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical At the Dry Cleaner's phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering drop-off, stain care, complaints and alterations. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, do you do dry cleaning here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ, du ju du draɪ ˈklɪnɪŋ hɪr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有的，大部分衣服我們都洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a wool coat and shirts.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə wʊl koʊt ænd ʃɜrts./
dialogue.zh: 我帶了一件羊毛大衣和幾件襯衫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, put them on the counter.
dialogue.zh: 好的，請把它們放上台面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The coat needs dry cleaning only.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很好，我們也會順帶檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One shirt has a loose pocket.
dialogue.zh: 有件襯衫的口袋鬆脫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 小縫補在我們店裡不收錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for the wool coat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We try to keep it low.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can I pick them up?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這是一般服務的時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, that is a bit much.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, normal timing works for me.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，一般時間我可以配合。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那就星期五三點後來取。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay now or later?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cards and cash are both fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I add these pants too?
dialogue.zh: 這條褲子也能一起洗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please hang them, do not fold.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hang all coats and shirts.
dialogue.zh: 大衣和襯衫我們都是掛起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The last shop folded everything up.
dialogue.zh: 上家店什麼都摺成一團。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這樣您也省了熨衣的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is paper inside my pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 別在意，這種事天天都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is this little paper slip?
dialogue.zh: 這張小單子是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So this gets my clothes back?
dialogue.zh: 所以憑這張單取回衣服？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I change my order later?
dialogue.zh: 之後還可以調整訂單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 在星期四中午前打電話，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you already have my number?
dialogue.zh: 你們有我的電話號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You wrote it on the form.
dialogue.zh: 您剛剛在表格上寫過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah yes, I filled that out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We text when clothes are ready.
dialogue.zh: 衣服好了我們會傳簡訊通知。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can also call to check.
dialogue.zh: 您也可以直接打電話問。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine in the morning, every day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a lot out back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, the back lot is easy.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，後面那位子好停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好好清洗後味道會去掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I wear it to work.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smoky jackets come in all the time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsmoʊki ˈdʒækɪts kʌm ɪn ɔl ðə taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 這種煙味外套我們常遇到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你們用的藥劑很強烈嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have a gentle green option.
dialogue.zh: 我們有溫和的環保選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the green one mean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 洗劑較溫和，幾乎沒有氣味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will try green this time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好選擇，很多客人都改用它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring a bag next time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ brɪŋ ə bæɡ nɛkst taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 下次要自備袋子來裝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們會用塑膠套把衣服包好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 塑膠套可以退給你們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, reuse them or bring them back.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˌriˈjuz ðɛm ɔr brɪŋ ðɛm bæk./
dialogue.zh: 可以，自己重複用或退回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One shirt is missing a button.
dialogue.zh: 有件襯衫掉了一顆鈕釦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep a box of spares.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, for small repairs like this.
dialogue.zh: 有，就是為了這種小修補。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do the clothes go now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They go to our back racks.
dialogue.zh: 會送到後面的掛衣架區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sort them by color?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 會，白色、彩色和精緻衣物分開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That describes two of my shirts.
dialogue.zh: 我有兩件襯衫正是這種布料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它們會被加倍小心照顧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have a great rest of your day.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ə ɡreɪt rɛst ʌv jɔr deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 祝您接下來的一天愉快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, one shirt has red wine.
dialogue.zh: 等等，有件襯衫沾了紅酒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look at it closely.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh wine stains usually come out.
dialogue.zh: 新鮮的紅酒漬通常洗得掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 通常的意思就是不一定，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We treat it first, then wash.
dialogue.zh: 我們會先去漬，再正式洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you use on wine?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A special spray, then cold water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does hot water set the stain?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, heat locks the wine in fibers.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hit lɑks ðə waɪn ɪn ˈfaɪbərz./
dialogue.zh: 會，熱量會把酒鎖進纖維。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Washing at home spreads the wine.
dialogue.zh: 在家自己洗只會讓酒漬擴大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you get those clean too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 領子會洗得像新的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And this one has black ink.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 墨水是我們遇過最難對付的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ink often leaves a light shadow.
dialogue.zh: 墨水常留下淡淡的印子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你們能保證完全去漬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please try your hardest on it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, we never give up on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔrs, wi ˈnɛvər ɡɪv ʌp ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 當然，我們不會放棄嘗試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old set stains need extra work.
dialogue.zh: 舊的頑固污漬才要多花功夫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This white blouse is pure silk.
dialogue.zh: 這件白色女衫是純絲的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 絲綢要用我們的溫和程序。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個程序有什麼不一樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的上衣還會保持光澤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 絲綢會保有自然的光澤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A shop once ruined my silk.
dialogue.zh: 之前有家店把我的絲衣洗壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sleeves grew rough and yellow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們這裡每個人都受過訓練。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 皮革交給專門的店家處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that done in this shop?
dialogue.zh: 那個是在你們店裡做嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a partner store handles leather.
dialogue.zh: 不，由合作店家處理皮革。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I get it on Monday?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The label says dry clean only.
dialogue.zh: 它的洗標寫著僅限乾洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then never wash that at home.
dialogue.zh: 那就千萬別在家裡洗它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I washed a sweater once. It shrank.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑʃt ə ˈswɛtər wʌns. ɪt ʃræŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我洗過一次毛衣，結果縮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 縮過的羊毛能恢復原狀嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有時候我們會輕輕拉伸回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please try that on this sweater.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This dress has tiny glass beads.
dialogue.zh: 這件洋裝綴著小玻璃珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 釘珠衣物必須手工清洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is fair, it is delicate.
dialogue.zh: 很合理，它本來就很精緻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 漂亮的洋裝我們會小心處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 在這裡顏色會褪色串色嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We check each item's color first.
dialogue.zh: 每件衣服我們都先檢查顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you test a color?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One drop on a hidden seam.
dialogue.zh: 在隱蔽的縫線處滴一滴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bad color runs ruin whole batches.
dialogue.zh: 串色會毀掉整整一批衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My blue shirt faded at the old shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ blu ʃɜrt ˈfeɪdɪd æt ði oʊld ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 我那件藍襯衫在舊那家店退色了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sun and dryer heat cause fading.
dialogue.zh: 日曬和烘乾的高溫是退色主因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So dry it away from sun?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 陰涼處晾乾讓顏色更持久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is coffee on these trousers.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, fresh coffee comes out easily.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，新鮮咖啡很容易去掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And a little egg and butter.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 油性污垢需要更強的處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Barely, if we treat it fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mustard can leave a yellow trace.
dialogue.zh: 芥末可能留下淡黃的痕跡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A trace is okay with me.
dialogue.zh: 有一點痕跡我可以接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then leave the rest to us.
dialogue.zh: 那剩下的就交給我們吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This old tie is pure wool.
dialogue.zh: 這條舊領帶是純羊毛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It gets a cold gentle clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a small tear too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We sew small tears for free.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We like clothes coming back whole.
dialogue.zh: 我們喜歡衣服完整地回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the silk go now?
dialogue.zh: 絲綢的衣服現在放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 放進單獨的柔軟袋子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的釘珠洋裝也一起嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不，那件洋裝單獨包裝運送。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I trust you with my clothes.
dialogue.zh: 我把衣服放心交給你們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, here is my ticket.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me pull your order up.
dialogue.zh: 讓我先把您那批調出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 二十二號，約好星期五取。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you are right on time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here are the coat and the shirts.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɑr ðə koʊt ænd ðə ʃɜrts./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plus the blouse and the dress.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 等等，這件大衣看起來不對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The color seems lighter on it.
dialogue.zh: 它的顏色看起來比較淺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the label number.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, it is under the collar.
dialogue.zh: 你看，號碼就在領子下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 您說得對，這是拿錯的大衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am so sorry, let me search.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm soʊ ˈsɑri, lɛt mi sɜrtʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please find mine, it is wool.
dialogue.zh: 請找到我那件，是羊毛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours must be in the back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you find my real coat?
dialogue.zh: 你找到我真正的大衣了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Here is your wool coat.
dialogue.zh: 找到了！這是您的羊毛大衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, this shirt has a hole.
dialogue.zh: 還有，這件襯衫破了個洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A hole? Not when it came in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hoʊl? nɑt wɛn ɪt keɪm ɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who made this hole in my shirt?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu meɪd ðɪs hoʊl ɪn maɪ ʃɜrt?/
dialogue.zh: 誰在我的襯衫上弄出破洞？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our presser must have done it.
dialogue.zh: 一定是那台壓燙機弄的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我最愛的襯衫被弄壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, let us make it right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What can you do about it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can pay for a new shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn peɪ fər ə nju ʃɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以賠您一件新襯衫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or our tailor repairs the hole.
dialogue.zh: 或者我們的師傅把洞補好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he hides them very well.
dialogue.zh: 不明顯，他縫得幾乎無痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, I still want a new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm, aɪ stɪl wɑnt ə nju wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we will refund the shirt.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shirt price plus the cleaning.
dialogue.zh: 襯衫的錢再加上洗滌費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這樣一共是三十三塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, I can live with that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for being so patient.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the ink stain is still here.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ði ɪŋk steɪn ɪz stɪl hɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still? Let me see the mark.
dialogue.zh: 還在？讓我看看那個痕跡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the ink left a shadow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You did warn me about that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is lighter, but not gone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 但這件襯衫還是顯得舊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I agree, we will refund it.
dialogue.zh: 我同意，這件也給您退費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You will refund this one also?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three fifty back to you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 還有這件女衫摸起來粗粗的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 粗糙？絲綢應該很滑才對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你自己摸摸看，就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I paid for a gentle clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are right, that is on us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr raɪt, ðæt ɪz ɑn ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 您說得對，是我們沒做好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what happens to my blouse?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We replace it or refund you.
dialogue.zh: 我們換新，或是退款給您。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can order the same style.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以訂同樣的款式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About one week, if you want.
dialogue.zh: 大約一週，如果您願意等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 今天還是退款比較乾脆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then twenty five back to you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am truly sorry about this.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But we will review the case.
dialogue.zh: 但我們會檢討這次的狀況。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 員工訓練還有壓燙溫度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope my next visit is better.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp maɪ nɛkst ˈvɪzɪt ɪz ˈbɛtər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will be, I promise you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me bring it out now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope every bead is there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 您數數看，我們檢查過兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful, the first perfect one today.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，今天第一件完美的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的羊毛毛衣呢？軟不軟？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, feel how soft it is.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half my order came out fine.
dialogue.zh: 我一半的衣服都沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And we refunded all the rest.
dialogue.zh: 其餘有問題的我們都退費了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is ready Monday, don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will text when it is in.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl tɛkst wɛn ɪt ɪz ɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 請把那件仔細檢查一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please sign here for the refund.
dialogue.zh: 請在這裡簽名確認退款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello again, the leather jacket, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 清洗後我們會保養皮革。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leather oil, it keeps it soft.
dialogue.zh: 是皮革油，能讓它保持柔軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我上一件皮衣裂得很慘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有保養的皮革很少開裂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒有，您的帳全部結清了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 謝謝您，我們真的很用心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, I need alterations.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 改衣服我們店裡就能做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這件外套能收小一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sides, it feels too loose.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our tailor takes it in nicely.
dialogue.zh: 我們師傅會把它收得很合身。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please stand by the mirror.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Am I standing straight?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I always buy clothes too big.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you move these two buttons?
dialogue.zh: 這兩顆鈕釦能挪位置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will note it on your ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl noʊt ɪt ɑn jʊr ˈtɪkɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can I get them back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有的，我們提供季節收納。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個服務是怎麼運作的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We clean, box, and keep them.
dialogue.zh: 清洗、裝箱，再由我們保管。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you keep the boxes?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那裡不會有生蟲問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two dollars for each big box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Space is tight at home too.
dialogue.zh: 家裡的空間總是不夠用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When must I drop them off?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 十二月一號之前哪天都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你們會幫忙送回來的吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, free delivery in this town.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My living room curtains are filthy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring one panel, we will check.
dialogue.zh: 先帶一幅來，讓我們看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for a curtain pair?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At my old shop, express was late.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt maɪ oʊld ʃɑp, ɪkˈsprɛs wʌz leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我以前那家店，加急卻遲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I needed it by Thursday noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 星期五早上，遲了一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, express orders always go first.
dialogue.zh: 在我們這裡，加急件永遠優先處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, express tags jump the line.
dialogue.zh: 對，加急標籤直接排最前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們也討厭兌現不了的承諾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How late can I come today?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you open next Monday too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nine to six as usual.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have any discount cards?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 會員在這裡有什麼好處？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我每個月都有衣服要洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The math looks good to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 現在登記吧，只要兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 會員有免費收件服務嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is a member perk.
dialogue.zh: 有，那是會員的專屬福利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, that saves so many trips.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just text us the night before.
dialogue.zh: 前一晚傳個簡訊給我們就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I do with hangers?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Return them for a small credit.
dialogue.zh: 帶回來可以折抵一點金額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have ten from last time.
dialogue.zh: 上次的十個衣架我還留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring them, and save two dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is good for the planet too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɡʊd fər ðə ˈplænɪt tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want plastic covers back?
dialogue.zh: 塑膠套也要退還你們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 對，乾淨的我們會重複使用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hate to see plastic wasted.
dialogue.zh: 我不想看著塑膠被浪費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So do we, that is exactly why.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ du wi, ðæt ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli waɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我們也是，所以才這樣做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will sign up for membership now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl saɪn ʌp fər ˈmɛmbərˌʃɪp naʊ./
